EVAL-F-003-S1.title: Define External Research Link Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-003-S1.description: Define structured schema for external provider research links including source (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, state board), URL, label, and guidance text for user interpretation.

EVAL-F-003-S2.title: Implement Research Link Generation Logic
EVAL-F-003-S2.description: Implement backend logic to construct external research URLs dynamically using provider NPI and state, including Healthgrades, CMS NPI Registry, and supported state medical boards. Include labeling and guidance text per source and handle unsupported states gracefully.

EVAL-F-003-S3.title: Expose Research Links via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-003-S3.description: Integrate generated research links into provider detail response and expose them through evaluate_care_facade for downstream consumption.

EVAL-F-003-S4.title: Provider Detail Service URL Validation Integration
EVAL-F-003-S4.description: Validate generated research URLs within provider_detail_service using URL guardian pipeline, including cache reuse, failure fallback, and ensuring only validated links are returned.

EVAL-F-003-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S5.description: Add tests for link generation correctness, schema validation, provider_detail_service validation behavior, and end-to-end delivery via evaluate_care_facade.
